items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: we worked there with such groups as Joe Venuti as a leader for awhile

ctx.x: It wasn't much publicized. He's helped people financially that are down and out, he's a philanthropist in his own right. Whenever he can afford to be, and sometimes when he can't afford to be. He's helped people that were down and out get back on their feet, he pulled people out of a hat, he brought Joe Venuti back to the public.
